name: x265-converter
description: Local batch video converter to HEVC/x265 with CPU/GPU switch.

scripts.dev:web: node ./node_modules/nodemon/bin/nodemon.js --watch server.js --watch public --ext js,css,html --signal SIGTERM server.js
scripts.dev:electron: node ./node_modules/nodemon/bin/nodemon.js --watch electron-main.js --watch preload.js --watch server.js --watch public --ext js,css,html --signal SIGTERM --exec "set ELECTRON_DEV_PROFILE=1&& node ./node_modules/electron/cli.js ."
